purpose: Fresh PEMS07 accuracy probe for a one-scan variable-token Mamba with prediction-connected AutoCon representation fusion.
research_question: Can the variable-token Mamba preserve PEMS07 H12 accuracy while its prediction path remains faster than the neural baseline resource references?
selection_history: The architecture was selected solely from a PEMS07 synthetic forward resource probe: d_model=16, d_ff=32, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1, and prediction-connected representation fusion. No validation metric from seeds 2061/2062/2063 was used in selection.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory PEMS07 H12 probe. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result only justifies a fresh four-PEMS confirmation matrix with contemporaneous baselines.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint and train-only normalization
measure the fusion-enabled prediction path before accuracy interpretation

phases.name: pems07_h12_variable_mamba_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact prediction-connected AutoCon relation graph with lambda zero and train-derived peak lags.

phases.name: pems07_h12_variable_mamba_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact prediction-connected AutoCon relation graph with lambda 0.001 and train-derived peak lags.

primary_contrasts: candidate versus frozen historical PEMS07 TimeMixer validation mean
comparison_contract.resource_contract: The fusion-enabled PEMS07 B32 L96 C883 H12 prediction path was measured before launch.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, all-PEMS, long-horizon, or general time-series claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
If both active and null are more than 1% worse than the historical PEMS07 TimeMixer mean, stop this candidate route.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, make no causal AutoCon accuracy claim.
